newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner Q3 shr loss widens to $0.43.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner Q3 shr loss widens to $0.43.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Year-ago third quarter loss of $0.41 per share includes $42 million extraordinary loss on retirement of debt, net of $22 million income tax benefit in 1996 and $26 million income tax benefit in 1995. Earnings before the charge was a $0.30 per share loss.
Revenue figures for all periods reported represent combined figures for Time Warner Inc and Time Warner Entertainment Co LP.
Per share, net income/loss figures and average share figures in the chart are only for Time Warner Inc.
Per share figures for Time Warner Entertainment Co LP were not provided.

Net income for Time Warner Entertainment Co was $51 million for the current quarter, compared to $79 million for the year-ago period, and $221 million for the current nine months, compared to $149 million for the year-ago period.

Separately, Time Warner Inc revenues for the current quarter were $2.157 billion, compared to $1.981 billion for the year-ago period. Time Warner Entertainment revenues for the current quarter were $2.720 billion, compared to $2.363 billion for the year-ago period.
Time Warner and Time Warner Entertainment reported combined EBITDA rose 32 percent to $964 million for the quarter, compared to $729 million for the year-ago period.
